System pressure steady near 498-500 mbar with normal noise
Differential pressures stable ~0.8 and ~2.0 mbar, no blockage or flooding signature
Reflux ~0.4 L/h, distillate ~0.67 L/h, ratio ~5.5, fluctuating but stationary
